- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
- A passion for travel and a commitment to delivering exceptional customer experiences.
- Experience in staff recruitment, training, and development.
- Multilingual skills are a significant advantage.

Join the Happy Travels team and lead the way in creating unforgettable experiences for travellers and adventurers. Apply now to become our Travel Agency Manager and embark on a rewarding career journey!

Freight Tasker Pty Ltd, a digitally forward multi-national freight forwarder, is looking for an experienced full-time Software Developer with a background in the logistics industry. You will build the systems that run our forwarding and customs operations, working hands-on with CargoWise, Expedient and modern AI tooling.

About the Company

Freight Tasker Pty Ltd is a digitally forward multi-national freight forwarder with our Australian operations based in Brisbane. Technology sits at the centre of how we operate: we invest in automation, systems integration and practical AI to streamline forwarding and customs workflows, connect with partners and carriers, and deliver a faster, more accurate service to our customers. You will join an on-site team where your work goes straight into daily operations.

About the Role

This is a standalone role for a capable all-rounder who will oversee the technological advancement of the business. You will own our technology roadmap end to end: developing, testing, maintaining and documenting application code in line with user requirements and system and technical specifications, building integrations with our CargoWise and Expedient platforms, and embedding AI across our operations. You will work directly with the leadership team and operational staff, with the autonomy to choose the right tools and set the technical direction.

Key Responsibilities

•	Research, consult and analyse user, business and system requirements, and evaluate existing systems to identify deficiencies and recommend improvements.
•	Design, develop, test, debug, document and maintain program code in accordance with user requirements and system and technical specifications.
•	Build and maintain integrations with CargoWise (eAdapter, APIs, EDI, workflow and registry configuration) and Expedient, including data mapping, message handling and automation.
•	Develop and deploy AI-driven features such as document extraction, classification and workflow automation for logistics operations.
•	Write and maintain technical documentation, program specifications and test plans.
•	Support deployment automation, CI/CD pipelines and operational monitoring of production systems.
•	Identify and address security risks across the product lifecycle.
•	Advise leadership on technology strategy, evaluate emerging tools and platforms, and drive the company's digital roadmap.
•	Train and support operational staff in adopting new systems and AI tooling.


About You 

•	Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field, or at least 1-2 years of relevant professional experience with strong working knowledge of forwarding, customs and transport operations across air, sea and road.
•	Hands-on experience with CargoWise, including workflow configuration, eAdapter/API integration, EDI messaging or custom development.
•	Demonstrated experience developing with or integrating Expedient freight forwarding and customs software.
•	Experience building AI-enabled software with LangChain and with the models and APIs of all the modern frontier AI labs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta and xAI), including intelligent document processing and workflow automation in production systems.
•	Strong experience with AWS for hosting, deployment and cloud services.
•	Strong proficiency in one or more modern languages and frameworks (e.g. Python, C#/.NET, TypeScript/Node, SQL) and experience with REST APIs and EDI.
•	The self-direction to operate as the sole technical resource in the business, managing priorities and delivering without day-to-day technical supervision.
•	Excellent problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to translate operational logistics requirements into robust technical solutions.

What We Offer

•	Salary of $80,000 to $90,000 plus superannuation, commensurate with skills and experience.
•	Real ownership of the systems you build, in a business applying AI to day-to-day freight operations.
•	A collaborative on-site team environment in Brisbane.
•	Ongoing professional development, including support for CargoWise certifications and AI and cloud training.

Happy Travels is Australia’s leading backpacker travel agency, built on a passion for adventure and a commitment to creating unforgettable experiences. Despite the challenges faced by the travel industry in recent years, we’ve continued to grow by staying focused on what matters most - our people and our travellers.

We’re more than just a booking service. We’re a tight-knit, energetic team dedicated to helping backpackers and tourists make the most of their time in Australia, Fiji, and New Zealand. From once-in-a-lifetime tours to hidden local gems, we connect travellers with experiences that turn trips into lifelong memories.

At Happy Travels, it’s all about people, connection, and adventure.

Role Overview:

As a Travel Agency Manager, your primary focus will be to oversee the operations of our travel agency, ensuring exceptional service delivery and maximising sales performance. You will lead a team of Travel Sales Consultants, motivating and guiding them to achieve sales targets and provide outstanding customer experiences. A crucial part of your role will be the recruitment, training, and development of staff, ensuring they are equipped with the skills and knowledge to excel in their roles.

Key Responsibilities:
- Leading and overseeing the overall operations and strategic direction of the travel agency.
- Developing and implementing business plans and strategies to achieve company objectives and targets.
- Managing financial aspects, including budgeting, forecasting, and financial performance analysis.
- Building and maintaining relationships with key stakeholders, such as travel suppliers, partners, and clients.
- Analysing market trends and competitor activities to identify opportunities and threats in the industry.
- Recruiting, training, and mentoring staff members to ensure a high level of professionalism and service quality.
- Setting performance goals and KPIs for the team, monitoring progress, and providing guidance as needed.
- Driving sales and revenue growth through effective marketing, pricing strategies, and product offerings.
- Developing and maintaining operational policies, procedures, and standards to ensure efficiency and compliance.
- Handling escalated customer issues and complaints, seeking resolution, and maintaining customer satisfaction.
- Negotiating contracts and agreements with suppliers to secure favourable terms and conditions.
- Staying updated on industry regulations, compliance requirements, and best practices.
- Utilising technology tools and systems to streamline operations and enhance customer experience.
- Analysing data and metrics to evaluate performance, identify areas for improvement, and make informed decisions.
- Representing the company at industry events, conferences, and trade shows to network and promote services.
- Monitoring and managing risk factors, such as safety, security, and legal liabilities, to protect the company’s interests.
- Fostering a positive work culture and environment that encourages teamwork, innovation, and continuous improvement.

Benefits:
- Competitive salary with performance-based incentives and superannuation package.
- Opportunities for career advancement and professional development.
- Travel incentives and familiarisation trips.
- Exclusive discounts on transport and accommodation.
- A supportive and dynamic work environment.

Qualifications:
- 3+ years experience as a travel agency manager or Diploma or Higher plus 1 year of experience.
- Strong leadership skills with the ability to motivate and inspire a team.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
- A passion for travel and a commitment to delivering exceptional customer experiences.
- Experience in staff recruitment, training, and development.
- Multilingual skills are a significant advantage.

Australian Citizens & Permanent Residents are encouraged to apply.

Join the Happy Travels team and lead the way in creating unforgettable experiences for travellers and adventurers. Apply now to become our Travel Agency Manager and embark on a rewarding career journey!

We are partnering with a highly respected early learning provider to find a nurturing and dedicated Childcare Worker for their vibrant centre. This organisation is known for its commitment to nurturing children's growth through a play-based and holistic curriculum. With purpose-built facilities and a team of passionate educators, they create warm, inclusive environments where children feel safe, valued, and inspired to explore and learn.

Program Delivery & Child Development:
• Design and implement stimulating educational programs aligned with the Early Years Learning Framework (EYLF)
• Facilitate intentional teaching moments through play-based activities including storytelling, music, art and sensory exploration
• Observe and document children's progress to support individual learning goals and share insights with families
• Guide social-emotional development by modelling positive behaviour and conflict resolution strategies

Daily Care & Wellbeing:
• Maintain impeccable hygiene standards including nappy changing, toileting assistance and mealtime supervision
• Create predictable routines that provide children with emotional security while allowing flexibility for spontaneous learning
• Conduct thorough safety checks of indoor/outdoor environments and resources before activities
• Administer first aid when required and follow health management plans for children with additional needs

Family & Community Engagement:
• Build trusting relationships with families through daily conversations and formal progress updates
• Collaborate with room leaders to create displays that make children's learning visible to parents
• Participate in community events and centre initiatives that strengthen family connections

Compliance & Professionalism:
• Maintain current working with children check - first aid certification and relevant qualifications
• Contribute to quality improvement processes through reflective practice
• Attend staff meetings and professional development sessions to enhance practice

Skills & Requirements:
• Certificate III or Diploma in Early Childhood Education & Care (or ACECQA-approved equivalent)
• Proven 1-year minimum experience in long day care or similar setting.
• Demonstrated knowledge of EYLF and National Quality Standards
• Genuine passion for early childhood development with endless patience and creativity
• Current First Aid, Asthma & Anaphylaxis certificates as well as proof of vaccination
• Working with children rights
• Police check
• Strong communication skills to engage with children, colleagues and families
• References from previous employers

• Above-award wages for qualified candidates
• Paid professional development opportunities
• Supportive leadership team with realistic expectations
• Purpose-built facilities with quality resources

If you're ready to make your mark in early childhood education with an organisation that values your expertise, we'd love to hear from you.

Submit your resume and cover letter addressing your experience with the EYLF and your approach to play-based learning. Successful applicants will require valid working rights and must pass background checks.

Please note: We are acting as recruitment agents on behalf of our client. Employer details will be provided to shortlisted candidates.

ABN AMRO Clearing (AAC) is a leading global player in clearing and clearing related services and strives to optimize profitability, return on invested capital and shareholders value. We have offices around the world, operating in Sydney since 1998; other main offices are located in Hong Kong, Tokyo, Singapore, Amsterdam, London, Chicago and Brazil. AAC is ambitious and customer oriented, striving to provide the best integrated service package for the professional business. AAC is a reliable partner, with efficient operations, compliant to all regulations and with a sound risk framework. 

The Software Engineer role contributes to AAC’s mission to optimize performance, risk management, and operational excellence by designing, developing, and maintaining enterprise software systems. The position ensures that applications are scalable, reliable, and compliant with financial regulations across APAC. 

The Software Engineer will report to the RAMS APAC Product Owner and be responsible for end-to-end design, development, migration, and optimization of critical clearing applications. This includes: 
• Designing system architecture for applications across Linux, Windows, PostgreSQL, MS SQL, and DB2 environments. 
• Leading upgrades and migrations of legacy applications to modern frameworks (Java, Angular, Python, Perl). 
• Ensuring integration, scalability, performance, and maintainability across APAC platforms. 

Key Responsibilities:
1. Software System Design & Architecture 
o Design and implement robust, scalable software architectures for LCM applications. 
o Evaluate and select frameworks, tools, and technologies to optimize system performance. 
o Define database structures and interactions to support enterprise systems. 
2. Development & Engineering 
o Develop, test, and maintain software solutions in Java, Python, Perl, and Angular, aligned with architectural design. 
o Apply engineering best practices (Spring MVC, Spring Boot, Maven, Bootstrap CSS) to ensure maintainable and high-quality code. 
3. Application Lifecycle Management 
o Own the full software lifecycle, including design, coding, testing, deployment, and support. 
o Lead migration projects, upgrading legacy systems to modern platforms while maintaining system integrity. 
4. Technical Leadership & Advisory 
o Provide guidance to Product Owners and the RAMS team on system design, technical decisions, and software strategy. 
o Evaluate software solutions for cost, risk, scalability, and integration into existing APAC systems. 
5. Collaboration & Documentation 
o Work closely with IT teams, Chapter Leads, and APAC CIO to maintain alignment between business needs and software architecture. 
o Produce and maintain technical documentation, including architecture diagrams, operational procedures, and user manuals. 
6. Risk & Compliance Awareness 
o Ensure all system designs meet regulatory, security, and operational risk requirements. 
o Implement solutions to improve reliability, compliance, and performance of critical clearing systems. 

Required Knowledge and Experience Education: 
• IT-related university degree or equivalent. 
• At least 2+ years in software engineering or system architecture roles. 
• Experience in finance/clearing systems preferred. 

Technical Skills: 
• Software engineering and system architecture experience. 
• Programming: Java (mandatory), Python/Perl, Angular. 
• Frameworks: Spring MVC, Spring Boot, Maven, Bootstrap CSS. 
• Databases: PostgreSQL, MS SQL, DB2, including design and optimization. 
• Operating Systems: Linux, Windows, Unix. 
• Lifecycle management, software engineering methodologies, test management, and IT governance.

Travel Agency Manager

Happy Travels is Australia’s leading backpacker travel agency, built on a passion for adventure and a commitment to creating unforgettable experiences. Despite the challenges faced by the travel industry in recent years, we’ve continued to grow by staying focused on what matters most - our people and our travellers.

We’re more than just a booking service. We’re a tight-knit, energetic team dedicated to helping backpackers and tourists make the most of their time in Australia, Fiji, and New Zealand. From once-in-a-lifetime tours to hidden local gems, we connect travellers with experiences that turn trips into lifelong memories.

At Happy Travels, it’s all about people, connection, and adventure.

Role Overview:

As a Travel Agency Manager, your primary focus will be to oversee the operations of our travel agency, ensuring exceptional service delivery and maximising sales performance. You will lead a team of Travel Sales Consultants, motivating and guiding them to achieve sales targets and provide outstanding customer experiences. A crucial part of your role will be the recruitment, training, and development of staff, ensuring they are equipped with the skills and knowledge to excel in their roles.

Key Responsibilities:
- Leading and overseeing the overall operations and strategic direction of the travel agency.
- Developing and implementing business plans and strategies to achieve company objectives and targets.
- Managing financial aspects, including budgeting, forecasting, and financial performance analysis.
- Building and maintaining relationships with key stakeholders, such as travel suppliers, partners, and clients.
- Analysing market trends and competitor activities to identify opportunities and threats in the industry.
- Recruiting, training, and mentoring staff members to ensure a high level of professionalism and service quality.
- Setting performance goals and KPIs for the team, monitoring progress, and providing guidance as needed.
- Driving sales and revenue growth through effective marketing, pricing strategies, and product offerings.
- Developing and maintaining operational policies, procedures, and standards to ensure efficiency and compliance.
- Handling escalated customer issues and complaints, seeking resolution, and maintaining customer satisfaction.
- Negotiating contracts and agreements with suppliers to secure favourable terms and conditions.
- Staying updated on industry regulations, compliance requirements, and best practices.
- Utilising technology tools and systems to streamline operations and enhance customer experience.
- Analysing data and metrics to evaluate performance, identify areas for improvement, and make informed decisions.
- Representing the company at industry events, conferences, and trade shows to network and promote services.
- Monitoring and managing risk factors, such as safety, security, and legal liabilities, to protect the company’s interests.
- Fostering a positive work culture and environment that encourages teamwork, innovation, and continuous improvement.

Benefits:
- Competitive salary with performance-based incentives and superannuation package.
- Opportunities for career advancement and professional development.
- Travel incentives and familiarisation trips.
- Exclusive discounts on transport and accommodation.
- A supportive and dynamic work environment.

Qualifications:
- 3+ years experience as a travel agency manager or Diploma or Higher plus 1 year of experience.
- Strong leadership skills with the ability to motivate and inspire a team.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
- A passion for travel and a commitment to delivering exceptional customer experiences.
- Experience in staff recruitment, training, and development.
- Multilingual skills are a significant advantage.

Australian Citizens & Permanent Residents are encouraged to apply.

Join the Happy Travels team and lead the way in creating unforgettable experiences for travellers and adventurers. Apply now to become our Travel Agency Manager and embark on a rewarding career journey!

5 world class wine regions within an hour and winemakers available to share their personal experiences one on one, the worlds largest surviving koala population in the wild, natural Artesian spring fed hot pools on the side of Mount Lofty, and of course the sharing of our story here starting with the oldest surviving culture going through Arthur Hardy's gatsby-esque years of celebration to today - all on a long table with a glass of Adelaide Hills red, complete with campfire on the valley rim at sunset, surrounded by kangaroos and wallabies. Sequoia Lodge focuses on money can't buyn behind the scenes experiences in our beautiful region. These will centre around our brand pillars of food and wine, nature, wellness and history. Guests will come from all over the world, and initially from around the country seeking experiences that simply aren't available anywhere else in the world.

Also on Mount Lofty Estate sits the iconic manor Mount Lofty House was the most awarded hotel in Australia in 2019 and #1 hotel in South Australia according to Tripadvisor and the Australian Hotel Association Awards. Add a 3 Chef Hat restaurant, vineyards, 30 acres of gardens, day spa and cocktail bar, all perched on Mount Lofty Summit, only 15 minutes from Adelaide CBD and it simply sounds too good to be true. 

Our estate requires a Night Manager to assist in the overnight operations of both Sequoia Lodge and Mount Lofty House. These operations will be overnight focused on the night audit task list, in addition to reception, in room dining, and public area cleaning in the lodge and at Mount Lofty House. This role will work as part of the larger Mount Lofty Estate team reporting to the Assistant Lodge Manager, and working closely with other key department heads in the delivery of excellence. 

We believe in Old Fashioned hospitality, honesty and respect, team work, ownership, flexibility and passion being genuine in our care for others. The team love what we do, and having a lot of fun along the way is a must.

Our Night Manager will have direct responsibility for:
Ensure the safety and security of the property and the smooth and efficient running of the estate’s overnight operation
Effectively manage the daily reconciliation details of the estate’s trading
Conduct the night audit and oversee financial controls such as revenue auditing, account payable, and credit card transactions.
Collaborate with hotel management to monitor financial performance, identify discrepancies, and implement improvements.
Effective coordination and supervision of all guest arrivals and departures

Cleaning the lodge reception and lounge bar areas
Support the night cleaner in their role cleaning all other areas of the hotel
Effectively communicate with all departments of the hotel to ensure customer satisfaction is consistently achieved
Utilise the Front Office PMS to meet operational needs and produce accurate reports
Deliver outstanding service to guests of Mount Lofty House and Sequoia taking care of any requests during the shift
Prepare and deliver in room dining to guests overnight.

You will have the following: 
Previous leadership experience in a similar environment
In depth knowledge of Front Office standards and procedures
Authentic customer service, interpersonal & communication skills & be flexible in your approach
Impeccable grooming and presentation
Excellent organisation and time management
Proficient in using Microsoft Office Suite
Experience with a PMS - Protel or Opera preferred but not essential
Available to work weekdays and weekends including shift work

Sound exciting? We look forward to meeting you.
